summary: Create a LinkedIn developer app, associate it with a LinkedIn Page, and get Page super admin verification before requesting product access. If you own the Page you can self-verify; otherwise a super admin has up to 30 days to approve. Public distribution is blocked until LinkedIn completes app review, identity vetting, and organization access verification.

steps.title: Create a LinkedIn developer account and app
steps.detail: Obtain a LinkedIn developer account from https://www.developer.linkedin.com, then create a new LinkedIn application and copy the client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Associate app with a LinkedIn Page and enter app details
steps.detail: Enter your LinkedIn Page, upload an app logo (PNG or JPG stored locally), and enter the privacy policy URL in the Privacy policy URL field.

steps.title: Send app verification request to Page super admin
steps.detail: In the app Settings tab, click Verify, generate a URL, copy it, and send it to the Page super admin by email or LinkedIn Messaging.

steps.title: Complete Page verification (owner only) or wait for super admin
steps.detail: If you own the LinkedIn Page, paste the verification URL into your browser and complete verification yourself. Otherwise, the Page super admin has up to 30 days to approve or deny using the unique URL.

steps.title: Request access for Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect
steps.detail: Click Products, find Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect, and click Request Access.

steps.title: Add authorized redirect URL
steps.detail: Go to the Auth tab and add your redirect URI to the Authorized Redirect URLs for your app section, then click Update.

steps.title: Copy Client ID and Client Secret
steps.detail: Copy the app's Client ID and reveal/copy the Client Secret for configuring LinkedIn OAuth in your application.

blockers.symptom: Page super admin does not approve the app verification request.
blockers.fix: Resend the verification URL to the Page super admin; note that denial invalidates all generated links for that app.
blockers.escalate: Contact LinkedIn developer support if the Page super admin is unresponsive.

blockers.symptom: App review or organization vetting fails.
blockers.fix: Correct the access request form, use an approved use case, pass email and organization verification, provide a valid company website and LinkedIn Page, add a valid privacy policy, provide a valid screencast, avoid LinkedIn/Microsoft names in the app name, and comply with LinkedIn API data restrictions.
blockers.escalate: Contact LinkedIn developer support for questions about application status.

composio.notes: Check the toolkit page for managed auth. To bring your own app, register the redirect URI shown when you create a custom auth config.
